english.title: Use contrivance to scare / deter trout / salmon
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a contrivance, namely **(..SPECIFY..), whereby salmon or trout may have been scared, deterred or in any way prevented from freely entering and passing up or down a free gap at all periods of the year
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(3)(b) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings H2945 and H2946 for other offences under subsection 12(3)(b).
(ii) See offence wordings H2942, H2943 and H2944 for offence of doing an act to prevent salmon or trout from passing through a fish pass or take / attempt take fish going through a fish pass under subsection 12(3)(a).
(iii) This section shall not apply to a temporary bridge or board used for crossing a free gap, and taken away immediately after the person using it has crossed.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.
